reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text: They say they have a free version, but you have to give them your credit card for a “free trial that starts charging you. That is a scam.

reviews.title: Problems
reviews.text: Been having a lot of problems with the app lately, not quite sure what the heck is going on. Can’t seem to get the tracker to open anymore.

reviews.title: Great, when it works
reviews.text: I’ve now used this app for a few months, usually stops working for about 3 days. Then suddenly it works again. I reboot my phone, I clear the ram, I’m a geek so I do all the necessary things. But yet, it still fails 3 days out of a 4 day work week. Considering it’s an app that I have PAID for, it is quite annoying that it only works part time, even after updating it, uninstalling it, reinstalling it. I have the latest IOS device and software, so I don’t know what else to do besides throw my phone at the wall now

reviews.title: No way to swap it for day sleepers
reviews.text: It’s only set up for people who sleep during the nighttime there’s no night shift settings but could be cool

reviews.title: Unfortunately bad now
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for many years and even when I switched to other apps I’d come back to this one. The freezing now is unbearable I shouldn’t have to keep a backup app in case this one doesn’t load. Today, the alarm just didn’t go off; it’s happened before but I really needed to be up early to have my day set up properly, so this was my last straw

reviews.title: loved it until..
reviews.text: loved it until its stopped working a couple months ago? was my go to alarm app and loved how it worked. but now everytime I try to set an alarm the app immediately shuts down and closes out. figured it was a bug but I keep checking for updates and nothing is coming:(
